en.title: Microsoft Edge: CVE-2026-79200 Use-after-free vulnerability in Aura
en.summary: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) contains a use-after-free vulnerability in Aura tracked as CVE-2026-79200 with a CVSS score of 9.6.
en.impact: The sources do not provide detailed impact or precondition information.
en.fix: The sources do not list fixed versions.
checks: Check systems for the Microsoft 2026-Aug security update context mentioned in the source.
